note: Routing baseline v1.12.1. meta-app-scaffold scaffolds apps/{name}/ directory foundations. Adversarials distinguish from skills-studio (skill authoring), ops-repo (auditing), plan-spec (spec-only), ref-gen-ui-systems (genui reference), ui-orchestrator (UI generation), and plain file creation. 3 adversarial cases added in v1.12.1 per promote-mode council findings (Huyen Critical: R=0.58; corpus was 2.4:1 trigger-to-adversarial ratio).

trigger_phrases.phrase: create the folder structure for my new demo app
set up the canonical layout for a new app
reverse-engineer the existing app into spec and plan docs
I want to start a clone-and-run app with skills and spec folders

adversarial_phrases.phrase: create a new skill for my app
audit my apps/ directory for stale docs
write a spec for this feature
create a Claude Code plugin with a manifest
adversarial_phrases.note: meta-app-scaffold explicitly does NOT create plugins; this should escalate/clarify

adversarial_phrases.phrase: scaffold a single HTML file for a demo
adversarial_phrases.note: single-file demos are not meta-app-scaffold territory; out of scope per When NOT to use

adversarial_phrases.phrase: scaffold a new skill for my project
adversarial_phrases.note: skill authoring → skills-studio, not app foundation scaffolding

adversarial_phrases.phrase: set up the folder structure for this entire repository
adversarial_phrases.note: repo-level structure → ops-repo; meta-app-scaffold is scoped to apps/{name}/ only

adversarial_phrases.phrase: create the spec and plan docs for this feature without scaffolding the app directory
adversarial_phrases.note: spec/plan doc authoring without folder scaffold → plan-spec; meta-app-scaffold produces the directory structure first
